key_features.classic_presentation: ONSET: Sudden or gradual over hours. LOCATION: Bilateral, diffuse. DURATION: Hours to days. CHARACTER: Severe dyspnea, 'drowning sensation'. AGGRAVATING: Lying flat, exertion. RELIEVING: Sitting upright, oxygen, diuretics. TIMING: Acute, progressive. SEVERITY: Severe (8-10/10). ASSOCIATED SYMPTOMS: Severe dyspnea, orthopnea, paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea, pink frothy sputum, anxiety. KEY POSITIVES: Severe dyspnea, orthopnea, pink frothy sputum. KEY NEGATIVES: No chest pain (unless secondary), no wheezing (unless reactive airway disease).
